# "endpoint | path" the demo may answer though Jira's recording lacks it,
# each with its reason. The recording is LAN on corne-team: a team-managed
# project, where the demo is company-managed.

# Story Points is a number field (float) in company-managed projects;
# team-managed ones have Story point estimate (jsw-story-points).
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/backlog 200 | issues[].fields.customfield[float]
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.customfield[float]
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/sprint/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.customfield[float]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | fields.customfield[float]
POST /rest/api/3/search/jql 200 | issues[].fields.customfield[float]

# LAN has no text or select custom fields; the demo's Test notes, Legacy
# ref and Team are.
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | fields.customfield[textarea]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | fields.customfield[textfield]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | fields.customfield[select]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | editmeta.fields.customfield[textarea]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | editmeta.fields.customfield[textfield]
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | editmeta.fields.customfield[select]

# Team-managed projects have no components.
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | editmeta.fields.components

# Jira leaves max out of a column without a WIP limit; LAN sets none.
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/configuration 200 | columnConfig.columns[].max

# Jira leaves parent out of an issue without one; LAN's sprint has none.
GET /rest/agile/1.0/board/{id}/sprint/{id}/issue 200 | issues[].fields.parent

# Mentions and emoji carry attrs; LAN's comments have neither.
GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} 200 | fields.comment.comments[].body.content[].content[].attrs
